description: Signed account webhook (returns secret). Events: domain.registered, domain.registration_pending, domain.registration_completed, domain.transfer_started, domain.transfer_completed, domain.renewed, domain.expiring, dns.changed. Verify X-StableDomains-Signature = sha256 HMAC of the raw body with the secret; retries for 24h, dedupe on X-StableDomains-Delivery. null to remove.
name: set_notification_webhook
title: Set notification webhook
